main_body: A bonsai-style pine tree: a leaning brown trunk with three flat green foliage pads (upper canopy, right pad, left pad).
top_band: Canopy pads: light green (#4e8355/#3a6c44) rows 1-8 at x=22, a mottled foliage mass with no separate top band. The trunk has no top surface.
evidence: This is an organic tree. The canopy pads are rounded clumps whose lighter upper rows show the foliage surface from above, with darker green rows underneath that read as the shaded underside. The trunk is a vertical organic form with no horizontal surface to require. There is no isometric side face, and the shape does not read as an architectural front elevation. Under the organic kind it reads acceptably as a 3/4 plant.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. Its canopy uses roughly 4 greens with some dither-like mottling, and the trunk has only 3-4 browns. The outline is dark green-black beside the foliage but a neutral-leaning dark purple (#231d28) beside the trunk, and 37% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, so it reads as a mixed outline with a partly sticker-like trunk contour. The references have rich leaf clumps, tinted outlines and several shading steps per material. Next to them the candidate looks thinner and flatter, with a sparse palette.
